intro.title: Better, together.
intro.intro: As Jack Johnson sings, we're better together. These are the partners I team up with to go further for the organizations we serve.

projects.name: Fun(d) Camp
projects.body: I've joined two former colleagues to bring high-ROI major gift training to organizations launching or rebuilding a major gifts program.

projects.name: Curmudgeon Group
projects.body: I've partnered with Curmudgeon Group, a creative agency dedicated to climate and environmental storytelling, on nonprofit partnerships and executive visibility.
